name: Pan-Roasted Sustainable Salmon with Glazed Carrots
whyItWorks: Pristine salmon filet pan-seared with olive oil delivers anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids and gentle protein inside Pirates of the Caribbean. Tender braised carrots provide digestible beta-carotene without tough cell walls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for salmon cooked with light olive oil and sea salt, skipping any spicy Cajun blackening rubs or heavy butter emulsion sauces.
